statement: NVL72 GB200 Blackwell racks are cited at $2.8 million to $3.4 million per unit, with Vera Rubin NVL72 pre-shipment inquiries at $5 million to $7 million per unit
why: These are static rack price levels quoted as context with no stated baseline or change, so they serve only as a display overlay on hardware pricing.

impact.mechanism: Rack-level system price levels describe where hardware pricing sits; without a stated prior level they carry no directional demand or supply information.

evidence.excerpt: NVL72 GB200 racks built on the Blackwell architecture were already priced at $2.8 million to $3.4 million per unit
Vera Rubin-based NVL72 VR200 systems have drawn pre-shipment inquiries of $5 million to $7 million per unit.

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregator; figures are per-rack ranges rather than a single per-GPU level, so no number is asserted.

dispersion: Quoted as ranges per rack, not a single point level; unit basis is per rack, not per GPU.
